summary: An agent roster fold that runs with no enclosing request and no pinned snapshot now reads in a snapshot of its own, as the roster refresher does, so its card-faults read is bounded by its CPU work clock and a scheduling pause no longer turns a real fault into "fault status unknown".

replay.detail: No graph replay or backfill; the same faults are read at the same cut.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger, schema version, claim kind or claim field changes.

rules.detail: No authority, write-rule, checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Request handlers carry a read budget and the refresher already pins, so their reads are unchanged; only direct callers outside both, such as tests, now pin. Response shapes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Ordinary binary restart; no ordering between members.

recovery.detail: In-memory read policy only; returning to the previous binary restores the unpinned read.
